desc: 浅蓝水洗丹宁珍珠钉珠毛边短裙：版型、面料手感、裙摆收边三线拆解
leaf: 浅蓝水洗珍珠钉珠毛边牛仔半身短裙
name: 浅蓝珍珠毛边牛仔短裙款

shots.intent: 用平涂色块场加双行大标题与竖排装饰字，在详情页首屏一秒锁住下滑流量。
shots.textZone: 顶部字距拉开的拉丁小标；上部 30% 双行大字标题区（带描边回声）；标题下一枚描边药丸标签；右侧竖排拉丁装饰字

shots.intent: 只露腰到裙摆的单品裁切加一条横向活动带，一秒把版型卖点与活动信息同框交付。
shots.textZone: 右上两行横向活动条（全部占位符，无数字）；裙摆下方一条细注

shots.intent: 在干净棚拍上用三枚实心点与引线讲清三个工艺点位，把结构卖点变成可视证据。
shots.textZone: 左侧纵列三组标注：粗体短标签加一行细注，各以细引线连到衣身点位

shots.intent: 以斜掠光微距交付表面装饰与切边毛须的真实质感，用手感与做工替代话术。
shots.textZone: 左下角一枚白色小卡，承载一枚短标签占位

shots.intent: 低机位仰拍把短裙放回真实夏日街景，用腿长比例完成自我代入。
shots.textZone: 左上双行标题反白压在虚化墙面上，标题下一行细注占位

shots.intent: 以两枚圆角编号卡把两个核心版型卖点分条拆解，图文各半便于逐屏下滑阅读。
shots.textZone: 两枚卡各含序号与双行小标题加一行细注，另一侧为单品照与微距小图

shots.intent: 正上方平铺加六枚线描图标，把面料手感诉求拆成可核验的可视细节。
shots.textZone: 平铺图下方居中标题一行；底部描边框内六枚圆形线描图标各配一枚占位标签

shots.intent: 同机位同光的三竖格让买家一次比完可选色，减少选色犹豫。
shots.textZone: 顶部居中标题一行；三枚色卡下方各一枚色名占位标签

shots.intent: 用两列参数、四条指数档与占位表格回答选码疑问，数值全部留给商家后填。
shots.textZone: 整屏为结构化占位文案区：标题带、两列参数行、四条四档指数条、带强调色表头的占位表格

shots.intent: 以整衣廓形加无印吊牌与收边细节收尾，用可核验做工承担信任而不编造资质。
shots.textZone: 上部双行收口标题；底部薄荷色带内三枚线描圆形图标各配一枚占位短标签

style.backgroundSystem: three alternating fields held to one flat graphic depth language: a #DCEBDD graphic field carrying #7EA23F halftone dot blocks and one vertical letter-spaced word down the right edge; seamless studio fields #FFFFFF and #EDEDEE; one real sidewalk scene with soft daylight bokeh

style.lightingSystem: bright even soft key from the front-left at 5500-5600K, bounce fill on the shadow side, single-direction low-contrast shadows, raking light reserved for texture macro screens only
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent fresh graphic womenswear detail-page visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of graphic field #DCEBDD, paper card #FFFFFF, ink text #2D2D2D and one accent #7EA23F plus one product-matched accent {accent_color}; cool-neutral tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with an oversized two-line headline carrying a thin outlined echo behind it and one letter-spaced latin kicker token above; backgrounds alternate between the #DCEBDD graphic field with #7EA23F halftone dot blocks and a vertical letter-spaced word down the right edge, seamless studio fields #FFFFFF and #EDEDEE, and one real sidewalk scene with soft daylight bokeh; bright even soft key light from the front-left at 5500-5600K, single-direction low-contrast shadows, raking light only on texture macro screens; matte paper, studio sweep and matte stone tile #E4E2DE surfaces, no gloss floor; rounded-corner paper cards floated on the graphic field, numbered highlight cards with hairline underlines, one slim horizontal offer band, four-step hollow index meters and one table with a solid #7EA23F header row; monoline circular pictograms inside hairline rings plus solid dot markers with hairline leader lines; the garment keeps its true fabric body, grain direction, surface finish, hardware and edge placement, rise and hem line at stable scale and the model face is never identifiable; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no membership badges, no real price or size numbers.
noDrift: no QR codes, membership badges or store marks
no real price, discount, size or composition numbers
style.presentationRules: rounded-corner #FFFFFF cards floated on the #DCEBDD field, numbered highlight cards with hairline underlines, one slim horizontal offer band, four-step hollow index meters, one table with a solid #7EA23F header row; the garment keeps its true fabric body, grain direction, surface finish, hardware and edge placement, rise and hem line at stable scale; model face never identifiable
